en: Fixed `CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_NONESSENTIAL_TRAFFIC` hiding the Claude apps gateway spend limit in `/usage` and the status line. The spend limit request goes to the gateway the session is signed in to
zh: 修复了 `CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_NONESSENTIAL_TRAFFIC` 导致 `/usage` 和状态栏中隐藏 Claude 应用网关支出限额的问题。支出限额请求会发送到 session 登录的网关
